scientific_integrity: Uniform symbolic proof of the pair-isomorphism groupoid and normalizer is supported by a replayable finite-field identity check, not replaced by that check. The initiating theorem and the general Witt-class theorem are credited; an older equivalent normalizer statement remains a residual originality risk.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns smooth genus-six curves over algebraically closed fields of characteristic two together with a distinguished cyclic subgroup of order twelve. It does not classify the full automorphism group, unmarked curves, or scheme-theoretic moduli over arbitrary bases.
title: Normalizer rigidity and exact parameter orbits for wild cyclic genus-six curves
